facts.business: Prima Agro Limited operates two cattle feed manufacturing plants in Kerala, specializing in contract manufacturing of customized ready-mixed compound cattle feed pellets for KSE Ltd.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Aims to bolster production capabilities by enhancing daily output at the Edayar unit by 50 tons

facts.related_party_note: Lease agreement with Ayyappa Roller Flour Mills Limited (entity in which Directors are interested) approved on 28.05.2026; Related party transactions with Prima Alloys Private Limited, Prima Industries Limited, Ayyappa Roller Flour Mills Limited, and Prima Beverage Private Limited (entities in which Directors/Promoters are interested) ratified for FY 2025-26.
